diagnosed_implementation_defects: Unconstrained Platt slopes can be negative and reverse the next OOS year's ranking.
The latest model always retained LightGBM even when the frozen Logistic/Ridge baseline was stronger.
Return heads were not reported against Ridge before retention.

only_changes.calibration: Non-negative monotonic Platt. A non-positive unconstrained slope falls back to the historical OOF prevalence and never reverses ranking.
only_changes.direction_selection: For each OOS year choose LightGBM only if it beats Logistic on all available prior OOS years, capped at three; otherwise choose Logistic.
only_changes.return_selection: For each OOS year choose LightGBM only if it beats Ridge on prior OOS MAE and RMSE without lower Rank IC; otherwise choose Ridge.

prohibited: use current-year labels for champion selection
